alerts.why: 5 cases of organophosphate within 7 days, 5 from skin or inhaled exposure while spraying
phorate is banned in India (CIB&RC) and still reached a patient: the product is still being sold or stored
4 poisonings from chemicals whose sale is restricted in India: aluminium phosphide, monocrotophos, paraquat dichloride

brief.headline: Organophosphate spraying cluster and banned chemicals in circulation drive acute poisonings across Blocks A–E

clusters.title: Organophosphate spraying cluster
clusters.detail: 5 cases of organophosphate poisoning within 7 days (28 Sep–3 Oct) after field spraying without masks; all involved profenofos. Row IDs: demo-01, demo-02, demo-03, demo-04, demo-05.

clusters.title: Banned chemical phorate still in circulation
clusters.detail: Phorate is banned in India (CIB&RC) but reached a patient in Block C; product still being sold or stored. Row ID: demo-09.

regulatory.title: Banned/restricted chemicals reaching patients
regulatory.detail: Monocrotophos (Ib), phorate (Ia), paraquat dichloride (restricted), aluminium phosphide (restricted) – all registered or restricted in India but still causing poisoning. Row IDs: demo-06, demo-07, demo-08, demo-09, demo-11.

what_published_cases_teach.title: Aluminium phosphide ingestion can cause delayed cardiac complications
what_published_cases_teach.detail: Case reports document delayed myocardial infarction and arrhythmias after aluminium phosphide ingestion; early suspicion of cardiotoxicity improves outcomes. URL: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10041262

what_published_cases_teach.title: Paraquat ingestion causes progressive acute kidney injury
what_published_cases_teach.detail: Published cases show paraquat ingestion leads to AKI requiring hemodialysis; early fluid resuscitation and antioxidants improve renal recovery. URL: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12768155

actions.title: Field visit to Blocks A, B, C
actions.detail: Verify pesticide storage, label integrity, and farmer protective practices during spraying.

actions.title: Farmer outreach on PPE
actions.detail: Emphasise mask, glove, and long-sleeve use during organophosphate spraying; advise re-entry intervals.

actions.title: Retailer inspection for banned products
actions.detail: Check shops for phorate, monocrotophos, and paraquat formulations not permitted for sale; seize if found.
evidence: regulatory alert: banned chemical in circulation

actions.title: Report to Poison Centre
actions.detail: Share register data and cluster findings with the district poison centre for early warning and antidote stock verification.

brief.confidence_note: All 12 register rows are marked as demo data; figures and clusters reflect demo data only. Date range: 28 Sep 2026 – 24 Oct 2026.
